rulings.Case Title: LO POST STREET LLC, A CALIFORNIA LIMITED LIABILTY VS. JOSHUA OWENS ET AL
rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for July 31, 2026. Line 12.1. Defendant's Demurrer to Complaint is GRANTED with leave to amend for Plaintiff to either attach "A copy of any written lease or rental agreement regarding the premises" or properly allege any exception(s) under CCP 1166. Ex. 1 currently attached to the Complaint is NOT the written lease or rental agreement. It is a Notice of Change of Terms of Tenancy, which necessarily means that there was a preexisting tenancy that is being changed. Plaintiff shall also allege that at least one of the grounds enumerated in SFRO 37.9(a) or (b) is its dominant motive for recovering possession.
